2124721053884719343.en_summary: Nvidia $NVDA is the AIG of AI: financing customers to buy its chips with billions in off-balance-sheet guarantees. If AI demand slows, it's not just lost chip sales—it's losses on those guarantees. The "picks and shovels" seller has become the bank of the gold rush.
2124721053884719343.zh_summary: 英偉達 $NVDA 是 AI 的 AIG：用數十億美元的表外擔保為客戶融資購買其晶片。如果 AI 需求放緩，不僅是晶片銷售損失——還有那些擔保的損失。「鍥和鏡」賣家已經成為淘金熱的銀行。

ticker_notes.NVDA: 用表外擔保融資客戶購買晶片，需求放緩有風險
